# Travel and Expense Policy (effective 1 October 2026)

## Meals
While travelling, an individual meal is reimbursed up to $45. An itemized receipt is required for any meal over $25.

## Mileage
Personal car use is reimbursed at $0.38 per mile. A trip log is required for any claim over 40 miles.

## Approvals
Any single expense over $600 needs manager approval before booking.
